title: The Wild Party at New York City Center #nyccencores #thewildparty #ja...
transcript: Last night's party was wild — it lived up to its title. This Encores revival of the Michael John LaChiusa and George C Wolfe musical tells the story of a group of people who, over the course of one uninhibited night, fly too close to the sun. It starts off as many parties do with spirits high and substances flowing, but as you might expect, the higher the high, the harder the crash. I was not familiar with this show or story at all, so I was absolutely shocked by the turns it took and equally impressed by the entire cast’s performance of this remarkably intricate score. The music is the centerpiece of this production — boisterously played to the nines by a full orchestra, it is brassy and gloriously crunchy. I found one duet between Jasmine Amy Rogers and Jelani Alladin especially transcendent. On the subject of casting, it's just as amazing as you'd expect for an Encores production. There are a few central relationships in the show, but it's really an ensemble piece with juicy material for a bunch of characters. The Wild Party is running at City Center through March 29th, and it's certainly a night to remember. With that, another program for my collection.
